title: M.A.D.E. run state machine
description: Normative. States, transitions, guards and per-State tool authority. The database CHECK constraint on runs.state, the routing predicates in made/orchestrator/routing.py and the toolbelt factory in made/tools/toolbelt.py MUST all agree with this document. Prose description: docs/02-architecture/05-orchestration-and-termination.md

guards.description: Rejects a TaskGraph containing a cycle, exceeding the Project Task ceiling, or containing any Task with an empty or absent verification_command.
Refuses a further Attempt when the Task cap (default 3) or the Run total cap (default 12) is reached. Counted from persisted Attempts so a restart cannot reset it.
Permits a retry only when the new Attempt has a patch hash unseen in this Task AND either a new normalised failure signature or a lower failing count than the previous Attempt.
Refuses re-entry when the tuple (state, task_id, workspace_tree_hash, sorted input artifact digests) repeats within a Run.

Pre-flight admission before every model call against Task, Run, Project and deployment ceilings, using a tokeniser-measured prompt estimate plus maximum output tokens. Refusal is a transition, never an exception, and never a tier downgrade.
Rejects patches touching paths outside the workspace root after symlink resolution, exceeding the size cap, or modifying CI configuration, git hooks or submodule pointers.

states.name: INTAKE
states.description: Validate the request, resolve the base commit, admit the budget, refuse a default-branch target.

states.name: PLAN
states.description: Produce a TaskGraph. Every Task must carry a verification_command.

states.name: TASK_SELECT
states.description: Select the next ready Task in topological order. Sequential only in v1.

states.name: IMPLEMENT
states.description: The role implied by task.kind produces a Patch. code->DEVELOPER, test->QA, iac->DEVOPS, docs->DEVELOPER.

states.name: VERIFY
states.description: Execute the Task verification_command verbatim in a Sandbox with no network. No model is invoked in this State and no write tool is available.

states.name: REVIEW
states.description: Advisory review of the diff. Cannot mark success.

states.name: TASK_DONE
states.description: Record Task completion and return to selection.

states.name: INTEGRATE
states.description: Run the Project full verification suite; after delivery approval, push the branch and open a pull request.

states.name: AWAIT_HUMAN
states.description: Durable wait carrying a reason and a resume_to State. The Sandbox is destroyed on entry and recreated on resume.

states.name: REJECTED
states.description: Refused at intake: invalid request, unresolvable base ref, policy violation, or no budget.

states.name: ABORTED
states.description: Cancelled by a human, or terminated by a wall-clock or approval TTL.

global_transitions.description: Operator cancellation. Destroys the Sandbox, records a terminal event, leaves the branch intact.
Run wall-clock TTL. Delivered as an event by the driver; never evaluated inside a routing predicate.

invariants: No transition has from == to. There are no self-loops.
Every non-terminal State has at least one outgoing transition to a terminal State or to AWAIT_HUMAN, directly or transitively.
No failure transition targets the State it originates from.
VERIFY has no model actor and no write tool, in every configuration.
AWAIT_HUMAN is the only State with actor 'human'.
DONE, REJECTED and ABORTED have no outgoing transitions.
